text:
Devon: Heads-up: seeing sustained egress tail latency spikes on eu-west dedicated pools between 01:00-03:00 UTC. Correlates with tenant X bursty downloads. Wondering if noisy-neighbor egress is tripping our per-pool NIC QoS and spilling to compute paths.
Sara: Yeah saw those graphs. Packet drops on eth0 tx_queue and >100ms p99 for short svc requests. Looks like nvlink unaffected, it's egress out of rack. Logs: `kernel: tx timeout` on 10.0.24.*
Kai: Could we soft-route heavy egress tenants to a 'seatbelt' pool that caps egress and routes non-urgent inferencing to preemptible nodes? Low-risk experiment.
Mike: Sounds reasonable. Need to check EU compliance for routing any traffic to preemptible infra (customer A has EU-only data). Also cost tradeoff: dedicated -> preemptible moves cost to infra but keeps SLOs.
Devon: Proposal draft: (1) noise-fence: per-tenant egress token bucket enforced at source NIC (2) seatbelt routing: when token exhausted, route to quantized/low-cost model variants or dedicated preemptible pool, with explicit region check. Canary in eu-west small cohort.
Sara: Implementation thoughts: we can use eBPF policer to avoid kernel drops. eBPF maps to track token buckets per tenant id; fallback enforced at proxy layer. Quick proto:
```
# eBPF pseudo
map tenant_tokens
on_tx(packet): if tokens[tenant] <=0 then mark -> REDIRECT seatbelt
```

Kai: If we redirect at proxy, we add additional latency. Need to set a tiny backlog for in-flight KV cache. Also keep canary percent low (1-2%) and add automatic rollback if p95 increases >20ms.
Mike: Who owns the canary? ops-sre + eng-infra. Sara can you spin up playbook for EU tenant opt-outs? We must not route regulated workloads.
Sara: Will do. Also add metrics: egress_bytes_blocked, seatbelt_redirects, downstream_p95, customer_impact_flag. Dashboards + alerts.
Devon: Cost estimate: small uptick in preemptible usage (est 8% cost increase) vs 30% reduction in tail latency incidents. Win IMO.
 scheduler-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary-eu-west-seatbelt v1 -> 2026-04-02 01:00 UTC (manual approval required)
Kai: I'll own rollout + quick smoke tests. Plan: 1% traffic for 2h, monitor, increase to 5% for 6h if stable.
Mike: Add runbook lines for rollback: `ip route delete` + drop eBPF map entries + revert proxy route. Keep slack channel #eng-infra notified.
Devon: OK, i'll PR the eBPF poc and policy config. tagging owners: @Sara @Kai @Mike. :thumbsup: 
Sara: ack, will prepare opt-out and compliance checklist.
Kai: ack, prepping smoke tests now.
Devon: Thanks. We'll review PR in morning.
